$comment: Gate modes for .claude/scripts/gate-check.py, one per check. shadow = recorded in .claude/evidence/ only; warn = recorded and printed; block = recorded, printed, and a FAIL stops the Stop hook (exit 2). JSON, not YAML, because gate-check.py runs on the Python standard library and a hand-rolled YAML subset fails silently (see gate-check.py § WHY gates.json). Inferential gates (G1 acceptance, G7 review — a judge decided), the behavioural-baseline gates (G4 perf, G14 behaviour — shadow until their measured noise is under 2%, proposal §6) and every other new gate or lens ship in shadow and moves to warn, then block, only after it has run on real changes with a measured false-block rate. Edit this file to tighten or loosen a gate for this project; CI v1 overrides every mode with --mode=shadow.
